parameters.name: BatchType
parameters.description:
The type of the batch operation. Valid values:

- **DOMAIN\_ADD**: Batch add domain names.

- **DOMAIN\_DEL**: Batch delete domain names.

- **RR\_ADD**: Batch add DNS records.

- **RR\_DEL**: Batch delete DNS records.

> If you leave this parameter empty, no filter is applied.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The task ID.

> If you specify a task ID, the results of that task are returned. If you leave this parameter empty, the results of the most recent task are returned.
